```{R}
library(dplyr)
df_name_cid <- read.csv("/home/gbiuser/Documents/vitoria/usp-masters/1-gutmgene/data/all_name_cid.csv", header=FALSE)
# df_name_cid <- read.csv("~/usp/usp-masters/1-gutmgene/data/all_name_cid.csv", header=FALSE)
load("~/Documents/vitoria/usp-masters/1-gutmgene/data/gutmgenem_processed.RData")
# load("~/usp/usp-masters/1-gutmgene/data/gutmgenem_processed.RData")

# Get the row indices where CID is NA
na_rows <- is.na(gutmgene_m$Metabolite_CID)

# Look up the CID from the other dataframe using the metabolite name
gutmgene_m$Metabolite_CID[na_rows] <- 
  df_name_cid$V2[match(gutmgene_m$Metabolite_Name[na_rows], df_name_cid$V1)]

gutmgene_m <- gutmgene_m[gutmgene_m$Microbe_Species != "uncultured",]
gutmgene_m <- gutmgene_m[gutmgene_m$Microbe_Species != "unclassified",]

gutmgene_m$Genus <- sub(" .*", "", gutmgene_m$Gut_Microbe_Name)
gutmgene_m$Genus <- gsub("\\[|\\]", "", gutmgene_m$Genus)
gutmgene_m$Genus <- gsub("\\.|\\]", "", gutmgene_m$Genus)
```

```{R}
mets <- c("10559720", "104775", "348154", "107", "10394", "6047")

genus_mets <- list()
for (met in mets){
  genus <- unique(na.omit(gutmgene_m[
                            gutmgene_m$Metabolite_CID == met,
                            "Genus"]
                          ))
  genus_mets[[met]] <- genus
}

all_species <- unique(unname(unlist(genus_mets)))

library(ggplot2)
freq_df <- as.data.frame(table(unlist(genus_mets)))
freq_df <- freq_df[order(freq_df$Freq, decreasing = TRUE), ]
rownames(freq_df) <- NULL

freq_df$Var1 <- factor(freq_df$Var1, levels = freq_df$Var1)

p_genus_mets <- ggplot(freq_df, aes(x = Var1, y = Freq)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#6FAF9C") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(1, max(freq_df$Freq), by = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Frequency of gut microbiota genera associated with the identified metabolites",
    x = "Gut microbiota genus",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size=10),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

ggsave(
  "p_genus_mets.png",
  plot = p_genus_mets,
  width = 8,
  height = 3,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

```
